description: GnuTLS supported by Nettle is a secure communications library implementing the SSL, TLS and DTLS protocols and technologies around them. It provides a simple C language application programming interface (API) to access the secure ommunications protocols as well as APIs to parse and write X.509, PKCS #12, OpenPGP and other required structures.
